title: Item Frame Count
description: Draws the stack count (x16, x64) over every item frame in view, so item-frame storage labels show their amounts at a glance.
body:
**Item Frame Count** is a clean overlay for anyone who labels storage with item frames. Place a stack of items in a frame and vanilla only ever shows a single icon Ă˘â‚¬â€ť the count is invisible. This mod draws that number for you.

### What it shows
- A small **xN** label floating right over every item frame within range that holds a stack larger than one (e.g. **x16**, **x32**, **x64**).
- Full stacks (**x64**) are tinted gold so a glance tells you which frames are topped up.

### Why
Storage rooms and item sorters often use item frames as labels, but the actual amount sitting in each frame is hidden by vanilla. Item Frame Count puts the number on screen so you can audit a whole wall of frames without breaking or opening anything.

### Controls
- **I** Ă˘â‚¬â€ť toggle the overlay on/off. An action-bar message confirms the state.

### Compatibility
**Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11** Ă˘â‚¬â€ť Fabric Loader 0.16+. One JAR covers all four. Pure client-side: install on your client only, works on any Fabric server, fully vanilla-compatible. Requires Fabric API.
